name: chain_stop
doc: Source: test_c147_chain_runner.test_no_automatic_cancel_then_stop_cancels_exit_3 (hang_in_item, busy worker). The STOP file lands after the barrier ack; the probe is cancelled, its partial leg archived under stopped/, rc 3. The STOP trigger is the log line `BARRIER ok` plus 0.3 s instead of the test's fixed 1.5 s sleep.
